correctness.rationale: Peak-by-peak Fubini integration exactly yields the Gram kernel K_t and <1,K_t^m1>. Similarity to a Volterra-integral kernel converts eigenfunctions to a Robin Sturm–Liouville problem; first-mode uniqueness gives the all-real k cot k / kappa coth k branches, including the t=2 continuity. Positivity improving plus compactness yields a simple gapped Perron root. Analytic perturbation supplies exact cumulants, Gaussian CLT, and the differentiable full-domain log-mgf gives the full LDP. Direct eigenquadrature, exact m=1 moment and six finite-m transfer diagnostics ran successfully (22 comparisons), but finite computation is not treated as proof.

originality.rationale: The 2023 source classifies snake base polytopes as fence order polytopes and analyzes combinatorial/lattice data; Stanley treats alternating-permutation volumes; Shonkwiler–Theis provides sampling and asymptotic one-coordinate means, which already imply the first-order clearance mean and are credited as known. The reviewed final claim is instead the complete peak-clearance Laplace-volume operator, explicit spectral pressure, variance/CLT and LDP. Targeted semantic searches of published findings and source text found no identical, stronger, equivalent, or implied claimed ensemble distribution, although a differently phrased older continuum transfer-operator calculation remains possible.

value.rationale: For a canonical lattice polytope, the sum of nonnegative incident facet clearances is a natural volume-geometric observable. Marginal means and the ordinary unweighted volume do not determine correlations across a growing fence. The explicit all-real tilted spectral root, nonzero asymptotic variance, Gaussian law and full large-deviation rate resolve the global clearance fluctuations and atypical near-facet volume at every height, providing a structural infinite-family invariant rather than a routine normalization or isolated finite value.
